_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. copy.ai's public surface is a Webflow site whose small --colors--* declaration (raw/css-vars.json — the brand palette plus the legacy --old-swatches--* set) is var-referenced where it names the brand and neutral values, and measured computed values (raw/components-computed.json) cover the ink/white neutrals, the #693ee0 action purple and its auth-host ramp, the black-button hover-to-purple state move, the hairline borders, the inset shadows, ABC Normal and Inter type, the 4/4.5/5/8/40/48px radii and the 0.1-0.4s control motion. The 'dark' set is the ink banner and the deep-purple card bands the light pages paint, not a user toggle.
